title: Practice 2: Adverbs of place, time and manner

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: What does с- add in спра́ва (“on the right, to the right”)?
options: place or manner of an action
shared participation in something, or shared belonging
the limit, the result of the action itself
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists спра́ва under this meaning of с-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «с-», meaning 9 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/с-).

exercises.q: What does из- add in извне́ (“from the outside, from outside”)?
options: destroying, reducing to nothing by use
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists извне́ under this meaning of из-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «из-», meaning 7 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/из-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: on the left; from the left
on the right, to the right
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: свыше — from above, on top; сле́ва — on the left; from the left; спра́ва — on the right, to the right; извне́ — from the outside, from outside.

exercises.q: What does из- add in изнутри́ (“from within, from the inside, from inside, out of”)?
options: destroying, reducing to nothing by use
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists изнутри́ under this meaning of из-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «из-», meaning 7 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/из-).

exercises.q: What does от- add in отны́не (“henceforth, henceforward, from now on”)?
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists отны́не under this meaning of от-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «от-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/от-).

exercises.q: What does от- add in о́троду (“(colloquial) never, for the whole life (since birth till present)”)?
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists о́троду under this meaning of от-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «от-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/от-).

exercises.q: What does от- add in отовсю́ду (“(colloquial) from all sides”)?
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists отовсю́ду under this meaning of от-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «от-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/от-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: from within, from the inside, from inside, out of
(colloquial) never, for the whole life (since birth till present)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: изнутри́ — from within, from the inside, from inside, out of; отны́не — henceforth, henceforward, from now on; о́троду — (colloquial) never, for the whole life (since birth till present); отовсю́ду — (colloquial) from all sides.

exercises.q: What does до- add in досыта (“(informal) to the full”)?
options: completing an action, reaching a goal
adding to what there was before
fullness, being brought to the utmost degree
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists досыта under this meaning of до-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «до-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/до-).
